Tesseract.js, for reading the words in a PDF's pictures on the Books tab (public/pdfread.js), without an AI.
Kept here so the Director works with no internet and no npm install.

  tesseract.esm.min.js, worker.min.js        tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache License 2.0)
  tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js           tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache License 2.0; LICENSE beside it)
  eng.traineddata.gz                         @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int (MIT; the Tesseract
                                             project's English model, Apache License 2.0)

https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
